title: QA: Guard awareness
eyebrow: Hand test for issue #479 (steps #480 to #489) on AjsAgent/guard-deep-dive-0031e3, with before and after co-op recordings

unverified: Nobody has played the new guards by hand yet.
My recordings show the host's camera, which mostly faces a wall, so the clips show less than the logs do. Play it yourself to judge.
In the floor-hole run after the changes, the guard ran off to a place it remembered from the scenario before, so that case is not shown working.
A guard hunting a lost player stops after 40 quiet seconds even when it is close. That cap is mine, not from the design.
Three stair-climbing guard tests (GuardClimbsTheStairToItsGallery) failed before this work and still fail.

short.lead: Every guard pick you approved is built and pushed, and all 569 play-mode tests pass. I recorded the five playtest scenarios in co-op before and after. Each item shows both; the logs say more than the pictures, so the sentence under each one is what the log recorded.
short.hint: Start the gym with the command in Start, then try each item.
items: Open the Ophan Gym in co-op

In Git Bash, from C:\Users\aj\Desktop\GameDev\PlunderSpell\.claude\worktrees\guard-deep-dive-0031e3, run: bash Tools/Unity/coop_local.sh --gym. You should see "Co-op on this PC is up". F8 stops damage to you; F9 removes the guards.
Run it once; every item below uses this session.
A guard 2 m beside you sees you
Before: the guard stood 2 m to your side and never noticed you. After: it saw you within a second and attacked (Combat at 1.0 s). Walk up beside a guard at a wall.

items.alt: Four frames of the after run, beside scenario
items.caption: After. Before: ../generated/guard-awareness-qa/beside-before.jpg; clips beside-before.mp4 and beside-after.mp4.

items: A guard at a checked spot looks round

Before: the guard walked to the spot and stared at the wall. After: it turned, found you 9 m behind, chased and fought (Combat at 1.0 s, then Chase, then Investigate when it lost you). Make a noise, then stand behind where the guard will stop.
Say whether it looks round enough.

items.alt: Four frames of the after run, spot scenario
items.caption: After. Before: spot-before.jpg; clips spot-before.mp4 and spot-after.mp4.

items: A chase broken off behind cover

Before: the guard gave up within 1.4 s and went back to patrol. After: I hid you 20 m away out of its sight; it went to where it last saw you, found you, and fought for 10 more seconds. Break line of sight and run a room or two.
Say whether it hunts long enough, or too long.

items.alt: Four frames of the after run, pillar scenario
items.caption: After. Before: pillar-before.jpg; clips pillar-before.mp4 and pillar-after.mp4.

items: Three melee guards on one player
Before: they took turns, one swinging at a time. After: two swing at once and the third waits; guards chase at 5.5 m/s. Let three guards reach you.
Say whether that is too much.

items.alt: Four frames of the after run, trio scenario
items.caption: After. Before: trio-before.jpg; clips trio-before.mp4 and trio-after.mp4.

items: A guard and you either side of a beam hole

Before: the guard walked round the hole and reached you in 7 s. After: inconclusive; the guard went to an older lead instead. Have the Ophan break a floor (F7), then stand across the hole from a guard.
Say whether it goes round, or holds and throws.

changes: No route: the long way round, or hold below and throw.
ChaseState, InvestigateState, GuardNearestReachableWalk; HoldBelow now steps back into view.
Only castle stone blocks sight; three-layer cone; 31.5 m calm range.
Turn toward sounds, look round, hear through doorways, 1.5 times range.
Back to patrol only after 8 quiet seconds and 3 rooms away.
Chase 5.5 m/s, alarm speed bonus on every move, two melee swings at once.
GuardTuning, GuardNavigator, AttackTurnTuning, prefabs and scenes.
